description:
Is video mein aap dekhenge ke ek bhai road par sukoon aur khushu ke sath namaz parh raha hota hai. Lekin ek shakhs aakar use baar baar tang karta hai aur namaz ke dauran disturb karta rehta hai. Phir achanak teesra shakhs aata hai aur jo pareshan kar raha hota hai usay rok deta hai.
Yeh waqia humein sabr, imaan aur namaz ki ahmiyat ka paigham deta hai. Namaz Allah ki ibadat hai aur iski hurmat har Musalman par farz hai.
Agar aapko aisi Islamic aur emotional videos pasand hain to channel ko zaroor subscribe karein aur video ko share karein taake paigham sab tak pohanch sake. 🤍
